provenance.cell_rows: Headers row 5, biological replicates rows 6:8; columns A:N
provenance.feeding_rows: Headers row 5, time and experiment means rows 6:11; columns A:AQ
provenance.cell_unit: Fos expression relative to vehicle, 1 h treatment, 100 micrograms/ml; 3 biological replicates per condition except NS-1 R3A has one technical error.
provenance.feeding_unit: Cumulative food intake in grams, 0–3 h after 5 mg/kg IP in lean male C57BL/6J mice; 3 independent experiment means, 3 mice/group per experiment; individual-animal values not supplied.
provenance.normalization: Cell retained activity = (condition mean − vehicle mean)/(BRP mean − vehicle mean). Feeding retained inhibition = (vehicle mean − condition mean)/(vehicle mean − BRP mean), separately for each time point. Reference means are not paired with individual replicate IDs.
provenance.uncertainty: Show all reported biological replicate values (cells) or independent experiment means (feeding) and sample SD. No significance, equivalence, or biological replication count is inferred from pseudo-paired columns.
provenance.reference_normalization: Vehicle Fos values fixed at 1 are source-normalized values, not evidence of zero raw assay noise. Normalized replicate spreads condition on the group reference means; they are not confidence intervals.
provenance.summary_sheet_not_used: Recomputed from Extended Data 10a–c, not 10d. The 10d feeding percentages use different aggregation from the ratio of group means used here. Its BRP Neuro2a summary is 58.3293069, whereas the mean of its three explicit 10b observations is 61.6626402. The cause of this summary difference is not established.
provenance.reuse: Paper/source data are publicly accessible but article has publisher-exclusive rights. Publish only minimal derived numerical facts and original transformation code, with source citation; do not republish workbooks, figures, or upstream code.
provenance.limitation: BRP is a non-incretin peptide. These are not semaglutide-treated tumor data, and this control audit cannot establish GLP-1 receptor engagement or cancer effects.

repo_identity.license: No LICENSE file at pinned commit; upstream code not redistributed.
repo_identity.execution: Executed upstream get_cleavage_sites method and upstream regex-expression AST over checked-in FASTA, via a sequence adapter. Did not run full main.py, tissue_specificity, or FASTA writer.
limitations: A motif-based precursor prediction is not evidence of secretion, processing, amidation, receptor engagement, or biological activity.
Default repository spacing is 5 aa; the paper describes a 3-aa spacing screen. Both are inspected, not silently harmonized.
The inspected upstream split_fasta_sequence writer appends trailing fragments inside its loop and has a for/else append; it was not relied upon.
